Documentation.short_help: Store named camera presets in this node (per pipeline branch) and apply one to the active 3D view.
Documentation.long_help: Camera presets live in this source's own properties (CameraNames, CameraPositions, CameraFocalPoints, CameraViewUps, CameraLens), so a camera configuration is saved with this pipeline object and the ParaView state instead of a global view or script variable. The Cameras table is the normal editor: Add captures the active RenderView camera as a new row; Update overwrites the selected row from the current camera; Delete removes the selected rows; Apply sets Position / FocalPoint / ViewUp / ViewAngle / ParallelScale / ParallelProjection on the active RenderView camera and renders. Double-click a non-Name cell to apply that row. Rows are stored one per line; CameraLens is viewAngle,parallelScale,parallelProjection (0 perspective, 1 parallel). The source output is one vertex per preset at CameraPositions (point arrays CameraIndex / CameraName) and is shown with Point Gaussian, so the presets can be previewed in 3D; Point Label can label them with CameraName. The output alone never moves a camera.

StringVectorProperty.name: CameraNames
StringVectorProperty.label: Camera Names
StringVectorProperty.Documentation: Newline-separated preset names, in table order. Edited in the Cameras table.

StringVectorProperty.name: CameraPositions
StringVectorProperty.label: Camera Positions
StringVectorProperty.Documentation: Newline-separated camera positions, one "x,y,z" per row (row-aligned with Camera Names).

StringVectorProperty.name: CameraFocalPoints
StringVectorProperty.label: Camera Focal Points
StringVectorProperty.Documentation: Newline-separated camera focal points, one "x,y,z" per row.

StringVectorProperty.name: CameraViewUps
StringVectorProperty.label: Camera View Ups
StringVectorProperty.Documentation: Newline-separated camera up vectors, one "x,y,z" per row.

StringVectorProperty.name: CameraLens
StringVectorProperty.label: Camera Lens
StringVectorProperty.Documentation: Newline-separated lens settings, one "viewAngle,parallelScale,parallelProjection" per row. parallelProjection is 0 (perspective) or 1 (parallel).
